anchor: A magic stick I used at random turned the nearest bandit into statue-like rock over several rounds. Which item is this, and what undoes it?
Which magic stick with a random effect table can turn the closest foe to rock if it fails an endurance roll, retrying each turn?
Which magic stick for casters gives a bonus to spell attacks that rises with its rarity, from uncommon to very rare?
Which item needs me to bond with it before its benefits apply, and lets me ignore partial cover on attacks with my spells?
At sorcerer level 6, which feature lets me pick one of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison to partly shrug off and add Charisma to matching spell damage?
My sorcerer keeps getting scorched and frozen by enemies; is there a level-6 perk that lets me pick one damage kind to toughen against?
Which second-level ritual lets me name a kind of creature or greenery and learn the direction and distance to the nearest one within five miles?
What spell uses a hound's fur as its material component to sniff out the nearest specific wildlife within five miles of me?
What uncommon drink makes the first creature I lay eyes on within ten minutes of drinking it captivate me for an hour?
What magical liquid looks rose-tinted and fizzy with one heart-shaped bubble, and what happens to me once I drink it?
Which small folk stand about two to three feet tall, have speed 30, and can take another go at a die roll that comes up 1?
Which playable people can hide behind a creature one size larger than them and slip through spaces occupied by bigger creatures?
What rare jewel lets me look through it for ten minutes and see through illusions and invisibility out to 120 feet?
Which rare magic stone has three charges and regains one to three of them each morning at sunrise?
Which light, flexible substance makes heavy protective gear wearable under normal clothes and cancels its sneaking penalty and strength requirement?
I'm a sneaky type who wants medium or heavy protection hidden beneath everyday outfits without clanking. Does such a thing exist?
Which pack of tiny water-dwelling biters can squeeze into another creature's space and can't be knocked flat or stunned?
What's a multi-creature biting horde that can't be frozen in place or turned into stone, and whose bite hurts more when the target is already wounded?
Which colossal beast can reflect a spell back at its caster and deal double harm to buildings, and shrugs off fire and poison?
Which gigantic creature has 697 hit points and armor class 25, and can choose to pass a failed roll to resist, up to six times a day?
Which fiend fires a flaming tether at a foe within 60 feet, hauling it up to 30 feet closer and pinning it briefly?
When I begin my turn within thirty feet of a hellish foe that I can see, it can make me scared unless I resist with willpower. Which monster is that?
Which ranged weapon can shoot glowing arrows into a wall up to 60 feet away to create a magical climbing structure lasting a minute?
I need to climb a sheer 60-foot wall fast, with a conjured route that disappears after a minute. Which magic weapon does that?
Which sixth-level spell seals off a building's hallways in fog that misleads intruders at intersections and magically locks all the doors?
I want a 24-hour protective setup over up to 2,500 square feet, with a spoken passphrase letting allies pass. Which spell is it?
Which tiny eight-legged creature has only one hit point and can scuttle across ceilings and sense anyone touching its silk?
What tiny creature's poisonous chomp adds 2 poison damage on top of a single piercing hit, and has a climb speed of 20?
As a level 3 nature-themed caster, how many readied magic options can I have, and can I swap them after resting?
Can a nature-themed trinket I carry stand in as my channeling focus for nature magic?
As a martial artist, what internal energy pool do I get, and when does it refill after a short or long rest?
Which martial-arts moves can be powered by spending internal energy: two quick punches or kicks, a dodge-and-withdraw, or a dash with a doubled jump?
Which armored burrowing beast can feel tremors through the ground within 120 feet and lunge onto creatures to knock them flat?
Which large underground-dwelling monster has 94 hit points and two chomping attacks, and can jump up to 30 feet as a quick extra move?
Which hovering trinket circling my head gives me a boost on rolls to act first in a fight and on noticing things?
Which circling item lets me cancel a magic spell of eighth level or lower cast by a creature I see, burning out after canceling 20 levels?
What very rare held item gives me an edge when a magic effect tries to affect me?
I'm facing enemy casters; which held item makes their magical strikes against me harder to land?
What rare piece of jewelry holds 4 to 9 explosive orbs I can hurl up to 60 feet, each bursting into a blaze?
Which rare accessory lets me hurl several explosive orbs together, each extra one adding a six-sided die of blast damage up to twelve dice?
My rogue needs to scale a castle wall without ropes; is there a level-3 perk that makes climbing as quick as walking?
What level-3 rogue perk changes how far I can leap, letting dexterity replace strength in the calculation?
Which tough outlaw leader fights with a curved blade and a flintlock, and can raise its armor class by 2 to deflect a melee hit?
What small or medium raider has 52 hit points, speaks a secret criminal tongue, and can deflect blows with a weapon in hand?
At sorcerer level 2, how many spell-altering tweaks do I unlock, and can I apply more than one tweak to the same casting?
Can a sorcerer swap out one of their spell-reshaping choices when they level up, and when do they get more?
Which headwear pulls random objects and creatures out, such as a camel or elephant that vanishes after one hour?
Which headwear item, when rolled on a d100, sometimes yields a rope with a grappling hook, a bag of caltrops, or a dagger?
Which small flying predator gets an edge attacking a target when its flock-mates stand within 5 feet of that target?
What small winged animal with 7 hit points flies 60 feet and bites harder when its target is already wounded?
Which medium-sized big cat can scale surfaces at 40 feet and slip away from melee or hide as a quick extra move?
What feline beast with 13 hit points and a 50-foot speed deals 1d6+3 cutting damage per hit?
What martial-arts class starts with a spear and five daggers plus an explorer's pack, or alternatively 50 gold, and wears no armor?
Which character class gets a choice between a spear-and-daggers kit with an explorer's pack, or simply fifty gold?
Which first-level trick makes my letters look like gibberish to strangers, while my ally reads them as ordinary text for ten days?
How can I make a written note look like nonsense to thieves but readable to my friend, and can someone who sees through every disguise read through it?
Which sneaky informant has 27 hit points, climbs at 30 feet, and deals extra poison damage with a short blade and a hand-held crossbow?
Which humanoid snoop excels at reading lies, sneaking, and pickpocketing, and can run, duck, or vanish as a quick extra move?
Which ninth-level spell locks a visible creature within 30 feet in a lasting restraint, letting it avoid by a willpower roll, and blocks its teleporting?
What spell can seal a foe inside a tiny gemstone, underground grave, or warded pocket realm until dispelled, and needs a figurine worth 5000 gold?
Which titanic beast's tail can knock Huge or smaller foes flat, and whose roar in a 150-foot cone deafens and frightens everyone?
Which colossal monster can gulp down a grabbed Large foe, digesting them with 16d6 acid damage at the start of each of its turns?
If I'm next to my friend and they're about to make a skill check, can I give them an edge, and does it last until my next turn?
On my turn, can I distract a nearby foe so my ally's next swing against it has an edge?
What first-level spell lets me sprint each turn, plus a second sprint as a quick extra move, for up to ten minutes?
I'm running from a fight; can I cast something that makes me faster on foot for ten minutes without spending my full turn?
At the highest cleric levels, when my restorative magic would roll dice to mend wounds, what number do I use instead?
Does a life-focused cleric get a power that makes dice-based recovery always pay out the top value, so 2d6 becomes 12?
What fifth-level magic fills a 20-foot ball with buzzing bugs for up to ten minutes, hurting anyone who enters or ends a turn inside it?
Which fifth-level area effect deals 4d10 damage with each higher slot adding 1d10, and punishes creatures that step into it?
Which seventh-level dark magic can strike a visible creature within 60 feet for 7d8 plus 30 life-draining harm, and raise slain humanoids as undead servants?
Which one-shot dark spell needs only spoken words and gestures, no materials, and reaches a visible target 60 feet away?
As a wizard resting briefly, how many total spell levels can I reclaim, and can I ever get back a sixth-level slot?
How often can a wizard regain used-up magic from studying their book, and does that have to wait until a full night's sleep?
Which magic cord of 60 feet can hold 3000 pounds, crawl along on its own toward a spot I pick, and tie or untie itself?
What enchanted cord can knot itself to shorten to 50 feet and make my scaling checks easier, with 20 hit points that heal over time?
As a barbarian at level 10, can I strike back with a weapon when a foe within five feet hurts me, using my reaction?
What barbarian path power gives me a free swing at a close enemy each time it damages me?
Which sorcerer level-3 feature gives my unarmored body a scaly-skin armor class of 10 plus Dexterity and Charisma modifiers?
Which sorcerer perk adds 3 to my maximum hit points at level 3, with one more each time I gain a sorcerer level?
